notes.title: Blind Drive turns one year old! 🍦🍦🍦 SALE + Original soundtrack out now 🎧
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113345/6728a6e424b366fb0ac3957487c5ac0b29504125.jpg[/img]

Blind Drive's 1st release anniversary is today!

What an amazing year it's been - thanks to all our players, you made it all so worthwhile!

🎧 [b]To celebrate, we've just released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932110/Blind_Drive_Original_Soundtrack
]the Original Soundtrack![/url][/b] 🎧

Featuring original tracks by the fantastic Ariel Mann as well as 2 tracks by stop-motion animated sensations Milgrom.

And of course, if you haven't yet played this crazy high-stakes audio sugar rush, what better time than now? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1300600/]Get it here[/url] - 30% off for birthday week.

More goodies in the near future, so stay tuned!

Love,
Giori & Doron

notes.title: New Update! - New languages localization and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113345/c016631d5b7c04bacf80b4700ecc7a1487c50186.jpg[/img]

Hey drivers! 

We are pleased to announce our new update is now live! 

[b]This update includes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Menus and subtitles in English, German, French, Spanish and Japanese.
[*] Difficulty adjustments.
[*] Easier audio cues in easy difficulty 
[*] Option to skip levels after several crashes.
[/list]

If you have any more requests or suggestions please feel free to post them in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1300600/discussions/]Steam Discussion page[/url]. 

And if you're enjoying the game, please leave a review, it really helps!

notes.title: Blind Drive is nominated for the IGF Awards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113345/42db804c2241206fa8b9e8842e303dacd33d64e7.jpg[/img]

Happy to announce that [b]Blind Drive[/b] has been nominated for the prestigious Independent Games Festival Awards in the Excellence in Audio 🔊 category!

We're thrilled and honored to be included in such an amazing list of games, as well as receiving an Honorable Mention for Excellence in Narrative!

Read all about it and see the full list of nominees [url=https://igf.com/finalists-and-winners]here[/url].
